# Security policy

## Report privately

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Use **Report a
vulnerability** in this repository's GitHub Security tab so the report enters a
private security advisory visible to the maintainer.

Include the affected published revision or Android Store version, the security
impact, the smallest safe reproduction, and sanitized supporting evidence. Do
not include live credentials, provider keys, pairing grants, private Hub URLs,
personal conversations, a complete MO state home, or unrelated logs. Revoke or
rotate any credential that may already have been exposed.

## Scope

Reports may cover the current published source or the official Google Play
build. A third-party provider, model, operating system, network, or self-hosted
deployment is in scope only when an MO defect creates or amplifies the security
issue.

This owner-maintained project does not promise a bounty, disclosure deadline, or
response-time SLA. Please keep the report private until the maintainer has
assessed it and coordinated any necessary release.
